body: U+0023# 2026-09-30: 10.17 follow-up specced, dispatched as PR #247, lab-testedU+000AU+000AU+002A*Spec and dispatch.**U+000AU+002D Spec: docs/specs/meadow-opening-recolour-stutter.md (interphase 0.4.0, bug pathway). Test 10.3 forces it; the output is identical.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Verification on the branch.**U+000AU+002D 30 test folders pass, `test/impeller` passes on both engines, the page goldens ran and passed with TZ=America/Edmonton, analyze is clean.U+000AU+002D Lab emulator, A/B against main, page and study cases:U+000A  U+002D longest frame 86–103 ms → 56–77 ms;U+000A  U+002D first case 103 → 77 ms;U+000A  U+002D scene ready 0.52–0.60 s → 0.74–0.77 s.U+000AU+002D Full screen on the emulator is excluded because of its own surface stall.U+000AU+002D Mac VM: the Meadow opens fully coloured, and slider drags settle consistently.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Code review.**U+000AU+002D Not blocking.U+000AU+002D Low 1: the mid-opening test should also assert that the scene appeared with out-of-date pieces.U+000AU+002D Low 2: with full screen open, the hidden page stage also draws one piece per frame, so a clock tick costs two bakes per frame for about 15 frames. This is a gap in the spec.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Still open.**U+000AU+002D 10.17 on the Note10+: at 18:10 the phone was not connected (adb: device not found).U+000AU+000AU+002A*Lab.** Instances are down.
